newsitem.title: USA: AgriBioTech Inc to acquire seed companies.
newsitem.headline: AgriBioTech Inc to acquire seed companies.

text.p: AgriBioTech Inc on Monday said it agreed to acquire Olsen-Fennell Seeds Inc and its affiliated companies, Rothwell Seeds International Inc and Westar Seeds International Inc.
The acquired companies, with annual sales of about $35 million, will provide AgriBioTech with a strong, profitable revenue base, Dr. Johnny Thomas, AgriBioTech's chief executive, said.
The company said in a statement the acquisition was contingent on the completion of due diligence and the negotiation of definitive purchase agreements.
